definitions.explanation: Careful thought and analysis of a subject.

{考察|こうさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧。

examples.english: It is necessary to examine the cause of the problem from various angles.

notes:
{考察|こうさつ} means thoughtful analysis or examination - careful consideration of a subject from multiple angles.

- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{考察|こうさつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧
